sources.title: 1 Introduction - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: CIPHER is a large language model fine-tuned on a specialized penetration testing dataset to assist ethical hackers by providing insights and recommendations. Trained on over 300 write-ups of vulnerable machines, hacking techniques, and open-source tools, CIPHER mimics expert reasoning and enhances the penetration testing process.
